title: offscript：一个品牌，三种性格
offscript: one brand, three personalities
summary: 同一家独立创意工作室，分别用杂志编辑、实验海报和未来数字的语气介绍自己。
One independent creative studio, introduced in an editorial, an unconventional and a future-facing voice.
brief: 为一家虚构的独立创意工作室设计首页首屏，表达它与众不同的态度。
Design the first screen for a fictional independent creative studio that wants to stand apart.

optimizes: 用材质感与叙事建立品牌价值。
Build brand value through texture and storytelling.
tradeoff: 视觉节奏舒缓，信息密度较低。
A slower pace with less information density.
bestFor: 精品品牌、生活方式、创意工作室。
Boutique brands, lifestyle and creative studios.

optimizes: 以大胆排版和撞色制造记忆点。
Create recall through bold type and clashing color.
tradeoff: 态度鲜明，不适合保守的品牌语气。
A strong attitude that may not fit conservative brands.
bestFor: 文化活动、新消费、独立创作者。
Culture, consumer brands and independent creators.

optimizes: 用空间感与数字质感传达探索精神。
Express exploration through space and digital materials.
tradeoff: 氛围较强，需要简洁而清晰的文案。
Atmospheric visuals need clear, concise copy.
bestFor: 设计工具、科技产品、数字艺术。
Design tools, technology and digital art.
